description: Language-agnostic law for the sync card's draft -> typed attach target (no URI round trip): (card kind, draft) -> null for an empty draft, an absolute folder, a file with its absolute folder, or a hub target host:port/space/document (a bare host:port/document names that document in the `default` space; host:port alone names the session's own document). Oracles: WHATWG URL (host + path segments) for remote drafts, node:path posix dirname for a file's folder.

cases.name: an empty draft is no target
an absolute folder stays as it is
a relative folder is made absolute
a file is backed by its folder
a file at the root is backed by the root
a remote draft names host, space and document
a remote document id may itself contain slashes
a bare remote document lives in the default space
a bare remote host names the session's own document
